gaps: Every breath-one bill was written as something presented to the mover, sooner or later, by a rule (Second undo is with prejudice, Second key for the way back), a material or an absence (Set like plaster, Way back rots), the interval's products (Writes in the interval), a body (Rebound above baseline), the counterparty or the room (Unsayable back, Retraction read by the room, Retraction louder than the claim), or a treasury (Second taxable event); pressing on Chair already given away and Strangers built on it produced bills delivered to chairs the mover never sits in, and pressing on Second taxable event showed a bill from a party who was never at the table, presented months after the reversal is done. This produced the changed question for breath two: to whom can the bill be delivered, whether there is a reversal whose cost is paid in a capacity nobody holds, whether a reversal can have to be executed inside what the move revealed rather than merely priced by it afterward, and who, if anyone, is in the business of collecting the bill for a way back.
accepted: Second undo is with prejudice: a rule meters reversals so that the first is free and the second costs the thing being reversed, as a plaintiff may dismiss a federal suit once by notice and a second voluntary dismissal of the same claim is an adjudication on the merits, as a retirement account may be rolled over once in twelve months and a second rollover is a taxed distribution, as the employer that takes a leaver back once reads the second leaving as the answer; the bill is borne by the mover; it is discovered at the second attempt, by the party who thought the first had been free, and it was readable in the rule before the first move by anyone who looked; the reversal cannot restore the count, since the count is what the reversal spent; not forms-of-return's Open-box refund, where the interval is priced onto the particular, since here nothing is marked and what is spent is a number kept by the rule.

Second key for the way back: the move needed one assent and the reversal needs a second that the move did not, as a raise given by a manager's signature is taken back, in much of Europe, only with the employee's consent or through a procedure the law sets, as a grant approved by a board is clawed back, absent a clawback clause written before the grant, only with the grantee's signature, as a wire sent on the payer's instruction alone is recalled only if the receiving bank and its customer agree, as a buyer who repudiates a signed contract hands the seller the election between holding the buyer to it and taking damages, and, in the unwritten form, as a perk given to a team is taken back only past the party the giving created, which holds the key by being able to leave; the bill is the second key's price and its delay, borne by the mover; it is discovered at the attempt, when the mover reaches for a hand that is not its own, and the written key was readable before the move; the reversal cannot restore the one-hand state in which the move was made, since the second hand, once used, has learned that it holds a key; where the rule runs the other way, as a treaty entered by two-thirds of a senate and left, in practice, by one signature, this item has no bill and the move is the costly leg; not term-sheet-powers' Veto priced by the clock, a class vote written at signing over named states, since here the key did not exist until the move made it.

Set like plaster: the moved thing hardens by a process of its own that ran while the move stood, so the reversal's bill is a demolition sized by elapsed time, as a blast furnace banked hot is brought back in days and one let go cold cracks its lining and is relined at the cost of a rebuild, as a vasectomy reversed within a few years usually restores fertility and reversed after fifteen does so less often, since the body has been making antibodies against what it no longer uses, as a temporary reporting line that stood a year is the organization and is reversed as a reorganization; the bill is borne by the mover; it is discovered when the quote for the way back comes in, and the quote's size is the date, so a mover who reads it learns how long the move stood; the reversal cannot restore the wet state, only produce a second setting; not lead-time-floors' Gestation, a replacement that must grow, since here it is the move that grew and the growing is the bill.

Way back rots: the reversal's precondition is held by someone or something outside the move and decays while nobody spends anything, as the old supplier's line is retooled for other customers, the two people who ran the old system leave, the part the old machine needs goes out of production, and the backup that would restore the old state has never been restored from and is found, at the attempt, to be unreadable; the bill is borne by the mover; it is discovered at the attempt, as an absence rather than a price, and it was invisible before because nothing was being paid, so a mover who wants the option must rehearse the reversal while the move stands, a small order to the old supplier, a restore drill, a retainer, and pay the rehearsal as the option's price; the reversal cannot restore the day the way back was still there; not lead-time-floors' Understudy, a spare finished and waiting for the day the source dies, since here the spare is the old source itself, aging while unused, and not pivot-invariants' preservation state from which idle equipment can be recommissioned, which names the asset whose absence this bill is.

Writes in the interval: the move opened a period in which new things were made in the move's form, and the reversal has nowhere to put them, as a schema migration is reverted in a minute if nothing has been written and in a week if a month of rows carry a shape the old schema cannot hold, as two merged companies are separated under a transitional services agreement whose whole purpose is to keep paying for the months in which one payroll, one ledger, and one contract book were made, as a rule implemented across an industry is repealed while the filings made under it are still owed; the bill is borne by the mover and by whoever made the writes; it is discovered during the reversal, row by row, when the first thing with no old-form home is found; the reversal cannot restore a state in which the interval's products do not exist, so it must either carry them in a shape they were not made for or delete what people made in good faith; not forms-of-return's Hard reset, the return that deletes the interval and pretends it never happened, since that is the choice this bill prices, and not pivot-invariants' working state that can be restored without reconstructing its history, which names the asset whose absence this is.

Rebound above baseline: the system the move acted on adapted to the move while it stood, so the reversal lands not on the original state but on the adapted one and overshoots it, as a beta-blocker stopped abruptly produces a heart rate and a pressure above where they were before it was started, as acid suppression withdrawn after months produces more acid than the untreated stomach, as a price cut restored reads to the customer as an increase because the reference price moved to the cut and stayed there, so the seller who takes back a discount faces a demand below the one the discount was given to lift; the bill is borne by the patient, the customer, the firm; it is discovered in the days after the reversal, by whoever is inside the system, and the mover often reads the overshoot as proof the move was needed; the reversal cannot restore the baseline, only reach a new one by a taper, and the taper is the bill's schedule; not risk-rebound-effects' Compensated cushion, where users spend a safety margin on new risk while the protection stands, since here nothing happens until the withdrawal.

Unsayable back: the move told the counterparty something, an offer, a number, a plan, a defect in diligence, and the reversal keeps the counterparty and leaves it knowing, so the mover lives with a hearer whose knowledge no longer matches any act, as a settlement offer withdrawn stays in the opposing lawyer's head though the evidence rule keeps it out of the trial, as a layoff announced and then cancelled keeps the staff, who now know where they stood on the list, as a code base shown to an acquirer who then walks stays shown; the bill is borne by the mover, in every later dealing with the hearer; it is discovered in the next round, when the counterparty anchors on the withdrawn number or the kept employee gives notice in a better market; the reversal cannot restore ignorance, and, unlike leaving the move standing, it leaves the knowledge unmatched by an act, which the hearer prices as bad faith or as weakness; not deal-deaths' Concession-made option, where a concession reveals a divisibility that kills the deal while it lives, since here the deal lives and the concession is withdrawn.

Retraction read by the room: the reversal itself is a signal the move was not, and third parties who never held a stake in the move update on it, as a recall tells the market the product is defective in a way the launch did not deny, as a tariff withdrawn under one partner's pressure teaches every other partner to press, as a term sheet pulled tells the next founder that the fund pulls, as a rate rise reversed at the next meeting tells the market that the bank does not know; the bill is borne by the mover, in dealings with parties who were not at the table; it is discovered at the next dealing, when the room prices the mover as one that reverses; the reversal cannot restore the room's prior; not walkaway-manufactures' Walk on record, where a record of walks buys credibility, since here a record of un-walks spends it.

Retraction louder than the claim: the reversal is published on a wider channel than the move was, by a rule that requires the notice and not the act, as a recall must be mailed to every registered owner while the sale was a line in a dealer's book, as hiring fifty people is a line in payroll and letting fifty go is a notice to the state that a reporter reads, as a paper is published in one journal and its retraction is flagged in every index that carries the paper, whether or not a reader of the paper ever sees the flag; the bill is borne by the mover; it is discovered by everyone at once and by the mover last, when the next counterparty mentions what it found in a search; the reversal cannot restore the move's obscurity, so a mover who expects to reverse should make the move on a channel no wider than the one the reversal will be forced onto; not witness-architectures, which asks what must exist for a trace to form, since here two traces form by rule and the asymmetry between them is the bill.

Second taxable event: the reversal is a second transaction to a party that was not at the table for the first, and that party bills both legs, as selling a thing to unwind its purchase realizes the gain and pays the duty again, as a house bought and sold within a year pays duty on the way in and tax on the gain on the way out, and in several jurisdictions a surcharge for selling so soon, as a conversion of a retirement account that could once be undone by the following October now cannot, so the unwind is a taxed distribution; the bill is borne by the mover and collected by the treasury; it is discovered at the next filing, by the accountant, months after the reversal has been done and often after the mover has spent the proceeds; the reversal cannot restore the basis, since the asset comes back with a new one; not dilution-carriers, which drain ownership by a route other than price, since here nothing drains and the two legs are simply both charged.

Hedge left naked: the move was one leg of a pair the mover built, and reversing it leaves the other leg standing as something else, as the loan repaid early leaves the swap that fixed its rate as a bet on rates, as the manager let go leaves the team hired under them as a team with no reason, as the market entered leaves the warehouse leased for it as a warehouse; the bill is borne by the mover, in the other leg's new nature and in its own reversal cost, which is a second bill of this map's kind; it is discovered when the other leg is next priced, by the treasurer who marks the swap or the director who inherits the team; the reversal cannot restore the pair, and the mover must either unwind the other leg, paying its bill, or hold it in its new nature; not risk-rebound-effects' Correlated hedge, where the hedge fails while paired, since here it is unpaired by the mover's own hand, and not Chair already given away, where the reliance is another's, since here the mover relied on itself.

Chair already given away: the counterparty acted on the move in a way it cannot take back, so the reversal restores the mover and not the counterparty, as the candidate who resigned on a signed offer finds the offer withdrawn and the old chair filled, as the carrier that positioned a vessel for a booking finds it cancelled, as the supplier that tooled for a program finds the program dropped; the bill is borne by the counterparty, and the law's answer, reliance damages, moves part of it back into the mover's account and rarely all, since the old chair is not for sale; it is discovered by the counterparty at the rescission and by the mover when the counterparty sues or when the next candidate has heard; the reversal cannot restore the counterparty's prior position; not clean-exits' Queue at the door, where exits are paced so that leaving does not hurt the stayers, since here nothing was paced and the bill lands on the one who moved for the mover.

Strangers built on it: parties the mover never counted built on the move, so the reversal's bill has no denominator, as an interface deprecated finds callers that were never registered, as a bus route cut finds a shift that was chosen for it, as a program of grants ended finds a town of small firms that hired for it; the bill is borne by the strangers, then by the mover when they surface; it is discovered after the reversal, by complaint, in a count the mover could not have made before, and the law's answer, the grandfather clause and the doctrine of legitimate expectation, is to exempt what was built and reverse only for those who have not yet built, which is the bill made explicit and paid in the reversal's incompleteness; the reversal cannot restore the strangers' builds nor the state in which no one had built; not risk-rebound-effects' Levee effect, where protection invites settlement while it stands, since here the settlement is the bill of taking the levee down, and not Chair already given away, whose reliers the mover can name and settle with.

residue.item: Anchor left behind: a price cut restored reads as an increase because the customer's reference moved to the cut.
residue.why: Merged into Rebound above baseline as its market case, since the reference price is a baseline that moved while the move stood and the restoration overshoots it in resistance; naming it separately would make one adaptation two items.

residue.item: Docket keeps the filing: the withdrawn suit stays on the docket, the pulled offering's filing stays in the register, the dropped charge stays in the arrest record.
residue.why: Rejected: the record was written by the move and the reversal merely fails to erase it, so it is the move's bill and not the reversal's, by the same fence that excludes sunk cost; what survived is the case where the reversal writes its own record on a wider channel than the move's, which is Retraction louder than the claim.

residue.item: Exception cited back: a one-time exception, once withdrawn, is cited by the next asker as precedent.
residue.why: Rejected: the precedent is set by the grant whether or not it is withdrawn, so the bill is to the rule and is incurred by the move; the reversal adds nothing to it.

residue.item: Everyone's undo at once: a move entered in a liquid market is reversed in one made thin by every other mover reversing at the same time.
residue.why: Held: a market condition that sizes several of this map's bills rather than a mechanism of one move, and runway-illusions' Hurry discount carries the spread; admitted only if a case shows the reversal ordering itself as a bill, the last to undo paying for the first.

residue.item: Termination fee: the reversal's price written into the move's own paper at signing.
residue.why: Rejected as in the move's own account by construction; kept as the boundary case, with the observation that it is what a bill on this map becomes once counterparties have been reversed on often enough to write it in.

residue.item: Sunk cost: the money the move spent that no reversal refunds.
residue.why: Rejected: the move's bill, not the reversal's; the fence for the whole map is that the reversal must add a bill that leaving the move standing would not have incurred.

gate: declared modality, recognizable distinction, defensible seriation and conditional relations
limits: Authored conceptual fieldwork, not a taxonomy or a partition; a real reversal, a divestiture, a cancelled layoff, a withdrawal, runs several of these bills at once, and the list makes no claim to cover every kind.

The seriation is an itinerary of when and to whom the bill is presented, not a ranking of size or of blame; the map edges are conditional authored claims, and the fork, loop, passages, conversion, and dependency they draw are interpretations.

The illustrative cases (the two-dismissal rule, the rollover limit, stamp duty, transitional services agreements, beta-blocker withdrawal, the 1967 Swedish and 1978 Okinawan driving-side switches, vasectomy reversal rates, recall and layoff notice rules) are simplified to expose one mechanism each and are not claims about specific transactions, nor legal or medical advice.

Costs written into the move's own paper, termination fees, break fees, notice periods, a priced release, are outside; clean-exits carries those, and the boundary case below says what happens to an item on this map once counterparties learn to write it in. Sunk costs, what the move spent and no reversal refunds, are outside, and so is a record the move wrote that the reversal merely fails to erase; only a record the reversal itself writes, wider than the move's, is in (Retraction louder than the claim).

A way back that is gone entirely belongs to the neighbor map on option expiry; every item here has a way back that can still be bought, and Way back rots is admitted while the price is finite. forms-of-return studies what sameness licenses a return and clean-exits what a leaving conserves; this map takes only the bill for coming back.

gaps: The changed question yielded bills delivered to other chairs and bills with no chair: a successor who takes the write-down for a move she did not make (Successor pays the write-down), a specialist who sells the way back at a price set by the mover's need (Only three shops undo it), a reversal that must be executed inside what the move revealed (Route the move revealed), a second truce that needs a prop the first did not (Truce needed no paper the first time), and finally a bill with no payer (Coordination spent), which the first framing could not hold because it assumed every bill is presented to someone. The territory pointer stands and the slug is kept; the of-sentence now sorts by when and to whom the bill is presented rather than by where it is kept. Second key for the way back was widened to carry the counterparty's own hand (the wire recall, the repudiated contract's election) and the unwritten key (the beneficiary who can leave), and it now names the inverted case, a treaty entered by two-thirds and left by one signature, where the move is the costly leg. The loop between Way back rots and Set like plaster came from the seriation: the two time-dependent bills compound through the mover's postponement, and a reversal not made early is made at a price both have raised. Coordination spent's strong form failed on Okinawa's 1978 return to the left, so it now claims only that the second coordination needs a date-setter from outside the group.
accepted: Only three shops undo it: the move is a commodity and its reversal is a specialty, so the mover bought from a hundred sellers and must undo through three, who price the reversal against the mover's need and not against their cost, as a tattoo is made by any parlor and removed by a clinic with a laser, as an integration is done by the acquirer's own staff and unpicked by the boutique that does carve-outs, as a system is installed by its vendor and torn out by the one firm that has done it before; the bill is the specialist's margin, borne by the mover; it is discovered at the quote, which comes with the number of other shops that could have given one; the reversal cannot restore the competitive price the move enjoyed, and no rehearsal makes a fourth shop, so the quote is worth getting before the move; not tollgates-that-must-buy, where the gate is compelled to buy from the passers, since here the gate stands only on the way back and sells; and not Way back rots, a capacity that was common and decayed, since this one was never common.

Route the move revealed: the reversal must travel the way the move came, in front of a party who learned that way by watching the move, as a unit that advanced up a valley withdraws down it under guns that have since registered every bend, as a firm that entered a market through a distributor leaves through the same distributor, who now knows exactly what the firm needs in order to get out; the bill is borne by the mover, in losses on the way back that were not taken on the way out; it is discovered during the reversal, by the adversary first and by the mover second; the reversal cannot restore the route's obscurity, so a mover who expects to reverse goes in by a route it can afford to be seen leaving by, or holds a second route it never used to go in; not Unsayable back, where the counterparty keeps what it learned and prices it later, since here the reversal must be executed inside what was learned; and not first-mover-forecloses, which shuts the rival's options, since here the mover's own move opened its own way back to view.

Successor pays the write-down: the move was made by an office and the reversal is made by a later holder of it, who takes the cost without having had the move's benefit, as the chief executive who acquired has left and the one who divests takes the write-down against their own year, as the government that cut the tax has left office and the one that restores it takes the blame, as the commander who ordered the advance has rotated and the one who withdraws signs for the losses; the bill is borne by the successor, in the record of their tenure; it is discovered on taking office, in the inherited position, and the predecessor never discovers it at all; the reversal cannot restore the credit for the move to the chair that pays for reversing it, so an office whose holders rotate faster than their moves can be undone will make moves and not unmake them, and the reversals wait for a holder with nothing to lose; not clean-exits' Chair filled before it's empty, which conserves continuity for the firm, since here the continuity is what delivers the bill, and not power-trades' Blame-bearer's fee, where the signature is paid to bear the blame, since the successor was never paid.

Truce needed no paper the first time: the state before the move was held up by something never written, a trust, a norm, a habit of not asking, and the move spent it, so the reversal restores the terms and must now hold them with a prop the first state did not need, as a ceasefire broken once is re-signed with monitors, as two firms that did not poach each other's staff and then did can now agree not to only in writing, which in many jurisdictions is a crime, as a couple reconciled after a leaving keeps the marriage with a counselor it did not have; the bill is borne by both parties, in the prop's cost and in the second state's visible dependence on it; it is discovered the second time, when a party notices that the terms are back and the ease is not; the reversal cannot restore the tacitness, since a thing once written cannot be unwritten back into a habit; not forms-of-return's Agamemnon's bath, where the place changed because of the absence, since here what changed is what held the place up, and not cooperation-ignitions, which asks how a first cooperation starts, since here the question is what the second one must be built on.

Coordination spent: the move was made by many hands at once, on a date set so that everyone changed together, and it consumed a willingness to change together that no single hand holds or can sell, so the reversal has no bill because it has no payer, as Sweden's drivers moved to the right on one Sunday in 1967 and no one has proposed the Sunday for moving back, as an industry that migrated to one standard at one deadline would migrate back only at a second deadline nobody will set; the bill is borne by the group, in the return's unavailability, and by no one's ledger; it is discovered when someone proposes the return and finds no one against it and no one to set the date; the reversal cannot restore the focal moment; the strong form is speculative and fails at Okinawa, which drove on the right under American administration and moved back to the left in 1978 on a date set by a returning sovereign, so the honest claim is that the second coordination needs a date-setter from outside the group, and where none exists the reversal waits forever; the map's other bills are at least presented to someone, so this is the stop where the walk ends, a reversal cheap for every hand and unavailable to all of them; not Truce needed no paper the first time, where what was spent was trust and paper can replace it at a price, since here nothing was spent but the willingness to switch on one date and no paper replaces a date; and not market-births' preconditions, which a market builds or imports, since here the precondition was spent and no one is in the business of resupplying it.

residue.item: Beneficiary at the door: the move created a party with standing to fight its reversal, the subsidy's recipients, the team with the perk, the patients on the drug.
residue.why: Merged into Second key for the way back as its unwritten form, since a beneficiary who can leave or organize is a key the rule did not write; the mechanism is the same, an assent the reversal needs that the move did not, and the difference is only whether the key was written.

residue.item: Way back is theirs to sell: the reversal needs the counterparty's consent that the move did not, the receiving bank on a wire recall, the employer one quit, the seller a buyer repudiates against.
residue.why: Merged into Second key for the way back as the case where the second key is the counterparty's own hand, with the contract repudiation's election as its legal form; a separate item would have sorted keys by holder, which is a sub-dimension and not a second mechanism.

residue.item: Proof the move left behind: the move's running while it stood is evidence against the reversal's stated reason, as two years of remote work argue against the memo that says the office is essential.
residue.why: Held: a bill to the reversal's argument rather than to its execution, close to Retraction read by the room; admitted only with a case where the reversal fails for want of a reason the move disproved, rather than for the room's reading of the reversal.

residue.item: Undo priced into the entry: the counterparty who has been reversed on before charges the reversal at the door, as setup fees, deposits, and minimum terms.
residue.why: Rejected: in the move's own account by construction; it is what an item on this map becomes once counterparties learn to write it in, and it is recorded in the boundary case as the migration that takes a bill off the map.

neighbors.left: Way back rots: the reversal's precondition is held by someone or something outside the move and decays while nobody spends anything, as the old supplier's line is retooled for other customers, the two people who ran the old system leave, the part the old machine needs goes out of production, and the backup that would restore the old state has never been restored from and is found, at the attempt, to be unreadable; the bill is borne by the mover; it is discovered at the attempt, as an absence rather than a price, and it was invisible before because nothing was being paid, so a mover who wants the option must rehearse the reversal while the move stands, a small order to the old supplier, a restore drill, a retainer, and pay the rehearsal as the option's price; the reversal cannot restore the day the way back was still there; not lead-time-floors' Understudy, a spare finished and waiting for the day the source dies, since here the spare is the old source itself, aging while unused, and not pivot-invariants' preservation state from which idle equipment can be recommissioned, which names the asset whose absence this bill is.
neighbors.right: Set like plaster: the moved thing hardens by a process of its own that ran while the move stood, so the reversal's bill is a demolition sized by elapsed time, as a blast furnace banked hot is brought back in days and one let go cold cracks its lining and is relined at the cost of a rebuild, as a vasectomy reversed within a few years usually restores fertility and reversed after fifteen does so less often, since the body has been making antibodies against what it no longer uses, as a temporary reporting line that stood a year is the organization and is reversed as a reorganization; the bill is borne by the mover; it is discovered when the quote for the way back comes in, and the quote's size is the date, so a mover who reads it learns how long the move stood; the reversal cannot restore the wet state, only produce a second setting; not lead-time-floors' Gestation, a replacement that must grow, since here it is the move that grew and the growing is the bill.
neighbors.separating_case: A firm moved off its old planning system two years ago and wants it back. Bring back the old vendor on a retainer and rehire the two people who ran it: if the old system now runs and the business can use it, the bill was rot, an absence held outside the move that money and time can refill; if the old system runs and the business no longer fits it, because two years of orders, roles, and habits were shaped to the new one, the bill was plaster, a hardening in the moved thing itself that no supplier can reverse. The two bills are told apart by what a rehearsal would have bought: a restore drill a year ago would have caught rot and would have done nothing about the setting.

checks.boundary_case: The early-termination fee, the break fee, the notice period, a reversal cost written into the move's own paper and priced at signing, is a tempting nonmember and is out: the fee is held in the move's own account, known to both hands before the move, and it is what clean-exits' priced release conserves. The ruling draws the map's fence: every item here is a bill that the move's paper does not carry, and the fee is what one of these bills becomes once a counterparty has been reversed on often enough to write it in, so the vendor who has been cancelled charges setup, the landlord who has been walked out on takes a deposit, and a bill that was Chair already given away migrates into the entry price and leaves the map. A second fence sits on the other side: sunk cost, the money the move spent that no reversal refunds, is out, since it is the move's bill and not the reversal's, and so is a record the move wrote that the reversal merely fails to erase, which is why the withdrawn suit's docket entry was refused and only the reversal's own louder notice was admitted.
checks.form_inference: The map shows a fork the sequence conceals: from Chair already given away, whether the mover can count its reliers decides whether the bill can be settled before the reversal, by reliance damages or a negotiated release, or arrives afterward without a denominator as Strangers built on it, so two items adjacent on the walk are one question apart in practice. It shows a loop, Way back rots → Set like plaster → Way back rots, carried by the mover's postponement: a rotting way back makes the mover keep the move standing rather than pay for an absence, during which the move sets, and the set move is quoted at a demolition that makes the mover keep it standing longer, during which the way back rots further, so a reversal not made early is made at a bill both processes have compounded. It shows a passage between levels at Chair already given away → Second key for the way back, where a bill in the counterparty's ledger becomes a key in its hand once the law or the paper gives the relier a say, and a second passage at Second key for the way back → Coordination spent, where a key held by everyone who moved together is a key no holder can sell, so the walk's second stop and its last are one condition apart. It shows a conversion at Successor pays the write-down → Retraction read by the room: the same reversal bills the successor's year or the mover's reputation depending on whose hand holds the pen, and cannot bill both. And it shows a dependency at Truce needed no paper the first time → Second key for the way back, since the paper the second truce needs is a key over any third move, so a reversal of this kind manufactures the next reversal's bill.
checks.target_preserved: Self-read only. Each admitted item names a distinct mechanism, who bears its bill, who discovers it and when, and what the reversal cannot restore; the strange members (a bill with no payer, a bill presented by a party never at the table a year later, a reversal that must be executed inside what the move revealed, a truce that needs paper the second time) are kept as mechanisms rather than softened into advice about thinking before acting; the author tried to collapse Way back rots into Set like plaster and could not, tried to collapse Retraction louder than the claim into Retraction read by the room and could not, and refused Docket keeps the filing and Exception cited back as bills of the move rather than of the reversal.

next_crossfield_opening: Bills that can be sold in advance and bills that cannot: connect the boundary case's migration, a bill that leaves the map once a counterparty writes it into the entry, with market-births' preconditions for pricing and with who-can-be-bound's holds, and ask which of this map's bills no seller can hold, Unsayable back, Truce needed no paper the first time, Coordination spent, so that no return policy, put, or re-migration guarantee can ever carry them into the entry price, and whether a mover can tell before moving which kind of bill the reversal will present by asking who could sell the way back today.

gaps: The closing item, Coordination spent, was out of type as written: 'the reversal has no bill because it has no payer' and 'unavailable to all of them' describe a way back gone entirely, which the map's own fifth fence assigns to option-expiries, and its mechanism, a willingness consumed, is contradicted by Sweden's 1967 switch, made by the Riksdag's date against a 1955 referendum to keep left; what survives is a bill the move's account did not show, a focal date supplied from outside for free whose return date must be manufactured, presented to no one until someone volunteers to set it. Successor pays the write-down contradicted its own edge to Retraction read by the room, since the incoming chief executive's first-year big bath clusters reversals at the handover rather than waiting for a holder with nothing to lose; now conditioned on whether the room grants a housecleaning window. Two cases sat outside the map's fences (a repudiated contract's election is the move's own paper; the lost Roth recharacterization is a way back removed, not a taxed unwind), and the loop's first edge fired before the mover could know the way back had rotted.
accepted: Second key for the way back: the move needed one assent and the reversal needs a second that the move did not, as a raise given by a manager's signature is taken back, in much of Europe, only with the employee's consent or through a procedure the law sets, as a grant approved by a board is clawed back, absent a clawback clause written before the grant, only with the grantee's signature, as a wire sent on the payer's instruction alone is recalled only if the receiving bank and its customer agree, and, in the unwritten form, as a perk given to a team is taken back only past the party the giving created, which holds the key by being able to leave; the bill is the second key's price and its delay, borne by the mover; it is discovered at the attempt, when the mover reaches for a hand that is not its own, and the written key was readable before the move; the reversal cannot restore the one-hand state in which the move was made, since the second hand, once used, has learned that it holds a key; where the rule runs the other way, as a treaty entered by two-thirds of a senate and left, in practice, by one signature, this item has no bill and the move is the costly leg; not term-sheet-powers' Veto priced by the clock, a class vote written at signing over named states, since here the key did not exist until the move made it, and not a signed contract's ordinary bindingness, the seller's election against a buyer who repudiates, since that is the move's own paper and outside this map.

Set like plaster: the moved thing hardens by a process of its own that ran while the move stood, so the reversal's bill is a demolition sized by elapsed time, as a blast furnace banked hot is brought back in days and one let go cold cracks its lining and is relined at the cost of a rebuild, as a vasectomy reversed within a few years usually restores fertility and reversed after fifteen does so less often, since the unused tract has been scarring shut and the body has been making antibodies against what it no longer releases, as a temporary reporting line that stood a year is the organization and is reversed as a reorganization; the bill is borne by the mover; it is discovered when the quote for the way back comes in, and the quote's size is the date, so a mover who reads it learns how long the move stood; the reversal cannot restore the wet state, only produce a second setting; not lead-time-floors' Gestation, a replacement that must grow, since here it is the move that grew and the growing is the bill.

Rebound above baseline: the system the move acted on adapted to the move while it stood, so the reversal lands not on the original state but on the adapted one and overshoots it, as a beta-blocker stopped abruptly produces a heart rate and a pressure above where they were before it was started, as acid suppression withdrawn after months produces more acid than the untreated stomach, as a price cut restored reads to the customer as an increase because the reference price moved to the cut and stayed there, so the seller who takes back a discount faces a demand below the one the discount was given to lift; the bill is borne by the patient, the customer, the firm; it is discovered in the days after the reversal, by whoever is inside the system, and the mover often reads the overshoot as proof the move was needed; the reversal cannot land on the baseline directly, only reach it, or a new one, by a taper, and the taper is the bill's schedule; not risk-rebound-effects' Compensated cushion, where users spend a safety margin on new risk while the protection stands, since here nothing happens until the withdrawal.

Second taxable event: the reversal is a second transaction to a party that was not at the table for the first, and that party bills both legs, as selling a thing to unwind its purchase realizes the gain and pays the duty again, as a house bought and sold within a year pays duty on the way in and tax on the gain on the way out, and in several jurisdictions a surcharge for selling so soon, as a stock sold at a loss and bought back within thirty days has the loss refused and folded into the new basis, so the reversal cancels the one tax benefit the move had; the bill is borne by the mover and collected by the treasury; it is discovered at the next filing, by the accountant, months after the reversal has been done and often after the mover has spent the proceeds; the reversal cannot restore the basis, since the asset comes back with a new one; not dilution-carriers, which drain ownership by a route other than price, since here nothing drains and the two legs are simply both charged.

Successor pays the write-down: the move was made by an office and the reversal is made by a later holder of it, who takes the cost without having had the move's benefit, as the chief executive who acquired has left and the one who divests takes the write-down against their own year, as the government that cut the tax has left office and the one that restores it takes the blame, as the commander who ordered the advance has rotated and the one who withdraws signs for the losses; the bill is borne by the successor, in the record of their tenure; it is discovered on taking office, in the inherited position, and the predecessor never discovers it at all; the reversal cannot restore the credit for the move to the chair that pays for reversing it; where the room grants a new holder a housecleaning window, the bill is lightest in the successor's first year and reversals cluster at the handover, the incoming chief executive's big bath, and where the room grants none, as with a tax restored or a withdrawal signed, an office whose holders rotate faster than their moves can be undone will make moves and not unmake them, and the reversals wait for a holder with nothing to lose; not clean-exits' Chair filled before it's empty, which conserves continuity for the firm, since here the continuity is what delivers the bill, not term-sheet-powers' Successor in the chair, where the later hand exercises a power it never signed, since here it pays for one, and not power-trades' Blame-bearer's fee, where the signature is paid to bear the blame, since the successor was never paid.

Coordination spent: the move was made by many hands at once, on a date that something outside the group supplied, a sovereign, a regulator, a deadline, an event, so the reversal's bill is a second such date, which no hand in the group can make for itself and which the move's account never showed because the first date came without being bought, as Sweden's drivers moved to the right on one Sunday in 1967 on a date the Riksdag set against a referendum that had voted to stay left, so the date-setter and not the drivers' willingness did the work, as Okinawa, which drove on the right under American administration, moved back to the left in 1978 on a date a returning sovereign set, and as an industry that migrated to one standard at one deadline would migrate back only at a second deadline nobody is placed to set; the bill is borne by whoever wants the return, in the price of finding or becoming a date-setter, and until one exists it is presented to no one; it is discovered when someone proposes the return and finds no one against it and no one to set the date; the reversal cannot restore the focal moment, only manufacture another; the claim is speculative beyond its cases, and its honest form is that the second coordination needs a date-setter from outside the group, so where none exists the reversal waits, not because the way back is gone but because its bill has no addressee, which is the stop where the walk ends; not Truce needed no paper the first time, where what was spent was trust and paper can replace it at a price, since here what is missing is a date and no paper replaces a date; and not market-births' preconditions, which a market builds or imports, since a group cannot import its own date-setter without becoming subject to one.
seed: The boundary case says a bill leaves the map once a counterparty writes it into the entry price, and Only three shops undo it shows a party in the business of selling the way back. Between them sits a map the record points at and does not contain: who sells undo, and what the existence of a seller does to a bill's place on this walk. Recall insurance sells against Retraction louder than the claim, a swap-breakage quote sells against Hedge left naked, a carve-out boutique sells against Only three shops, a restore-drill vendor sells against Way back rots, and a sovereign sells, when it will, the date that Coordination spent needs. The conjecture worth a breath is that every seller moves its bill leftward along the seriation, from discovered-after to quoted-at-the-attempt to priced-at-entry, and that the bills with no possible seller, Unsayable back, the no-poach truce, the stranger who never registered, are the ones that never migrate and so define what the map is about once the market has done its work.
